_readme: SCG members shown on /team/, grouped by level (levels, in order). Imported from the old site's About page (source: old-site). Fields: id, name, level (one of levels), title, cohort, majors (list; null until known, never guessed), experience (internship line from the old site, optional; shown on the /team/ tile), headline (one line under the name on the member's page /team/<id>/ and on their /team/ tile, e.g. "Past Audit Intern, EY"; null = no line), headline_company_break (optional, true: on the tile the text after the last comma wraps as one unit, so a company such as "Capital One" never splits across lines), bio (list of paragraphs, exactly as supplied; a member gets a page /team/<id>/ only with consent_to_publish: true and a non-empty bio), worked_on (project ids from projects.json; optional), photo (written by npm run assets from face detection: source, face box and focal point in % of the original; add focal_override {x, y} in % to move the face centre by hand; see README → Headshot framing); the file is assets/photos/people/<id>.*, linkedin (only if publicly linked; null otherwise), consent_to_publish (true to show), consent_basis, source. To add a person: add an entry, put their photo at assets/photos/people/<id>.jpg (or .png/.webp) and run npm run build. 'show_majors': false keeps majors as data only (no majors line or Major filter on /team/); set true to show them.
